CUSTOM_KNC_INGR_MACRO.shared: Same clip as in 426b77bb: generate ONCE and reuse in all 5 KNC general-ad rebuilds.
CUSTOM_KNC_INGR_MACRO.keyframe: Vertical 9:16 premium night-skincare studio macro: glossy deep-navy surface with soft reflections, dark-blue gradient background with gentle bokeh, warm key light plus cool blue rim light, shallow depth of field. Three small shallow round clear-glass dishes in a gentle diagonal from lower-left to upper-right, well separated. Dish 1 holds fine translucent pale-amber crystals (kojic acid). Dish 2 holds one glossy crystal-clear serum bead (niacinamide). Dish 3 holds a small mound of soft pearly-white powder (alpha arbutin). Clean empty dark space beside each dish for labels added in post. No jar, no packaging, no hands, no people, no text, no letters.
CUSTOM_KNC_INGR_MACRO.motion: Slow lateral macro dolly from dish 1 to dish 3, with a gentle rack focus landing on each dish in turn (about 1.6 s each). The crystals sparkle softly, the serum bead trembles and the powder glints. Nothing merges or moves between dishes.

rebuild.notes: No scanner HUD, skin terrain, molecular orbs or halo ending. The only woman is ANANYA. Night application, morning results, and no spots after application. New credits: one shared KNC CUSTOM clip.
rebuild.vo_budget_note: English VO is about 249 characters over 17.5 s. The regional dubs (spoken at about 14 chars/s, with numbers spoken as words, e.g. 'SPF fifty PA triple plus') will run longer, so transcreate tightly. If a language overflows, trim connectives first, never the ingredient names, 'Instant Glow' or the full product name.
